label: Drug ADME via organic anion/cation transporters
reason: Drug ADME pathways and SLCO/SLC22 organic ion transport all describe transporter-mediated xenobiotic disposition.

label: Stress-induced senescence and p53 apoptosis control
reason: Senescence/SASP terms plus regulation of p53-mediated DNA-damage apoptosis, linked by the p53 stress-response fate decision.

label: Neurotransmitter synthesis, transport, release and clearance
reason: Monoamine/GABA/glutamate/ACh biosynthesis, reuptake, vesicle loading, degradation and botulinum/tetanus release block; few odd transporters (bile acid, alkanesulfonate).

label: Glucagon/PKA control of hepatic glucose metabolism
reason: Glucagon-PKA signalling, F2,6BP, glucokinase regulation and glycogen turnover form one hepatic fasting programme; resveratrol is the lone oddity.

label: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and type I IFN
reason: cGAS-STING, RIG-I, IRF3 and TREX1 regulation all concern induction and control of type I interferon.

label: Innate antimicrobial defence against bacteria and fungi
reason: Antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration, bacterial killing/agglutination and antifungal humoral response share one host-defence theme.

label: Neuropeptide and stress regulation of behaviour, sleep
reason: Mating, aggression, fear, sleep/wake, CRH/corticosterone and orexin/neuropeptide signalling form a neuroendocrine behaviour theme.

label: Mitotic chromosome and nuclear envelope dynamics
reason: Chromosome condensation, cohesion, CENP-A loading, NE breakdown/reassembly and ESCRT abscission are all mitotic chromatin/NE events.

label: Early embryonic axis and neural plate patterning
reason: Axial mesoderm, notochord, floor plate, neural plate/border specification and D/V axis are one gastrulation/neurulation patterning theme.

label: Adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
reason: White/brown/beige fat differentiation, PPARG regulation, adipogenesis and cold/diet thermogenesis all concern adipose biology.

label: Trace metal, iron-heme and oxidative homeostasis
reason: Zinc/copper/cadmium handling, iron/heme biosynthesis and transport, and peroxide/ascorbate metabolism linked by metal-ion and redox homeostasis; a few odd members.

label: ERK/MAPK feedback, AP-1 and IL-6 signalling
reason: DUSP-mediated ERK/p38/JNK inactivation and AP-1 activation linked to IL-6/STAT3 via shared immediate-early MAPK-dependent signalling.

label: Protein quality control and selective autophagy
reason: Aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, CMA, microautophagy and misfolded-protein handling form one proteostasis theme.

label: Glycan biosynthesis: N/O-glycans and sialylation
reason: N-glycan processing, O-GalNAc glycosylation, sialic acid and glycosphingolipid synthesis plus related CDG defects.

label: Kidney nephron and ureteric development
reason: All members concern nephric duct, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme and nephron tubule morphogenesis.

label: Myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
reason: RUNX1, megakaryocyte/platelet development and myeloid progenitor fate regulation; generic cell-cycle module is minor.

label: Base excision repair DNA glycosylases
reason: All members are BER glycosylase recognition/cleavage steps and their OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1/NEIL defects.

label: Skin epidermis and melanocyte pigmentation
reason: Keratinocyte/cornification and MITF melanocyte pigmentation form a skin core; ~quarter are intestinal/hepatic HNF4-CDX epithelium modules and stray terms (TNF, synaptic vesicle coating).

label: Glucose, fructose and glycogen metabolism
reason: Glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, fructose catabolism, glycogen turnover, G6P transport and their inborn errors form central carbohydrate metabolism.

label: Insulin signalling and GLUT4 glucose uptake
reason: IRS/AKT2 activation, GLUT4 translocation via exocyst/RHOQ, insulin processing/receptor recycling and adiponectin are one insulin-action theme.

label: Ubiquitin chain synthesis and deubiquitination
reason: E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination, linkage-specific chains and DUB families (USP, OTU, metalloprotease) form one ubiquitin-system theme.

label: Synaptic vesicle cycle and receptor trafficking
reason: Clathrin-mediated SV recycling, presynaptic organisation and postsynaptic AMPA receptor trafficking all concern synapse membrane dynamics.

label: Glial fate specification and differentiation
reason: Oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cell differentiation/proliferation and myelination regulation.

label: Synaptic transmission and locomotor/exploratory behaviour
reason: Glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission regulation, sensorimotor gating and rodent behaviour phenotypes form one neurobehavioural theme.

label: Vascular development and endothelial specification
reason: Arterial/venous/lymphatic endothelial fate, vessel morphogenesis, outflow tract and BMP/SMAD signalling driving vasculogenesis.

label: TLR/LPS innate inflammatory signalling in monocytes
reason: TLR2/4/5-MyD88-IRAK4, LPS/CD14 transfer, lipopeptide responses and monocyte/myeloid modules form one innate sensing theme.

label: FGFR signalling
reason: All members are FGFR1-4 ligand binding, splicing, downstream FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades and oncogenic mutants.

label: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and its mutants
reason: RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK activation, negative feedback, GAPs and oncogenic/RASopathy mutants form one pathway theme.

label: Glial differentiation and myelination
reason: Oligodendrocyte/Schwann myelination, astrocyte activation/gliosis and axon calibre regulation are one glial biology theme.

label: Hepatobiliary bile acid and xenobiotic clearance
reason: Bile acid synthesis/recycling, bilirubin glucuronidation/export and hepatic drug transporters (SLCO, ABCC2, ABCB11) share hepatobiliary excretion.

label: Renal salt, water and osmotic homeostasis
reason: Vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, Na/K/Cl cotransporters, osmotic stress responses and blood pressure regulation form one body-fluid theme.

label: Ubiquitin-proteasome protein quality control
reason: Proteasomal degradation regulation, degron pathways, ERAD and misfolded protein responses form one proteolysis theme.

label: B-vitamin and one-carbon cofactor metabolism
reason: Cobalamin, folate, methionine/SAM, biotin, riboflavin and thiamine metabolism with their inborn errors; zinc and ubiquinol are minor outliers.

label: PTEN-PI3K/AKT and inositol phosphate metabolism
reason: PTEN/AKT signalling regulation and soluble inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis linked by phosphoinositide/inositol phosphate kinase biochemistry.

label: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and cristae
reason: Mitochondrial protein import, presequence processing, protease degradation and membrane/cristae organisation.

label: Coagulation cascade and factor VIII/IX defects
reason: Intrinsic/common coagulation pathway and defects of F8, F9 and FV are one haemostasis theme.

label: CSF1 signalling in macrophages and osteoclasts
reason: M-CSF/CSF1R signalling, macrophage proliferation and osteoclast differentiation/bone resorption; IL-37 is a minor outlier.

label: Myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
reason: RUNX1-driven HSC/megakaryocyte programmes, granulopoiesis and myeloid lineage fate regulation.

label: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome segregation
reason: Cohesion, condensation, meiotic recombination/synapsis, spindle checkpoint and CENP-A centromere assembly all serve chromosome segregation.

label: Cell cycle G1/S and G2/M control
reason: E2F/RB, cyclin-CDK regulation, G2/M checkpoint and mitotic entry/progression form one cell-cycle theme.
